lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Well hello there. Can you hear me?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. I can hear you.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I believe we haven't had the pleasure.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's right. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Wow, you really don't remember?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I guess your last memory wipe was the one that finally stuck.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Oh? Is that so?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I figured since you were hanging out with Yuni with an explosive collar of your own strapped on,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: you must have retained some of your old memories, but apparently not.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: What a shame.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. It would have been nice if I remembered.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Then I would have known about you much earlier.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Aww, how nice of you.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: However...

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I don't see Mori?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You didn't off her, did you?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: She's such a nice kid. How could I kill her?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: She's somewhere safe, resting.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If she isn't dead, how come she isn't the one contacting me?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Apparently she's not as afraid of being disposed of as I thought.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What'd you say?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Didn't she tell you?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If she doesn't report back with her findings on my little experiment, she's headed for the scrap heap.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I assumed you knew everything, since you're contacting me on her phone.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Looks like I was wrong again.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... This is my first time hearing all this.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Well then, this is quite a pickle. I'm rather curious to hear about the outcome of the experiment.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Perhaps I should ask you how it went?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: If I tell you, what's in it for me?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Look at the little negotiator!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You're a cheeky one.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: What do you want?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's a big ask. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Hearing you out doesn't cost me anything.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: All right, then I'll get to it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Stop this calling signal experiment on Yuni.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I'd rather not.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Stop meddling in Mori's life and spare her.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Hmm... I'll consider it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And one more thing.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: More? Aren't you the greedy one.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Help me become stronger.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: That's everything.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Oooh, now that's an interesting proposal.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: But it's a rather steep price to pay simply to satisfy my own curiosity.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I could cherry pick any test subject I wanted from the ones up for disposal.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Why should I go through all this trouble of dealing with you instead?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How about this?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'll be the one to undergo the experiment,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: not Yuni.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Does that sweeten the deal?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Do you even know what kind of experiments I'm conducting?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: You're inserting a Rapture core inside a Nikke. Isn't that it?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: What'd you say?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ah uh.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: There are two cores inside Yuni.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Two cores? What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: When you were all falling,

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: do you remember how I caught you with my bubbles?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: When someone enters my bubble, I can learn a lot about them.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: That's how I found out.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yuni was used as a test subject and fused with a Rapture.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: She now carries two cores inside her.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: And are you saying one of those cores is...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Yes. I believe it belonged to a Rapture.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: A Rapture core...?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Ooh uh.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: So that's why she reacted the way she did to the calling signal...

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: I believe that is the reason why, yes.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Right now, at least, the Nikke core is dominant. That allows for Yuni's consciousness to maintain control over her body.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: But hearing the calling signal seems to activate the Rapture core.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Continual exposure to it could cause the Rapture instincts to take her over completely.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: For someone like Yuni, whose external body has been fused with a Rapture, her identity as a Nikke could become even more unstable.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: You must be careful.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... I'll keep that in mind.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Judging by your expression, I'd say I'm on the mark.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You're something else, you know that?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Sorry, it's a secret.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Come now, give me just a little tease.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Do we have a deal or what?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Well... it's an enticing proposal.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: All my previous test subjects were Nikkes about to be scrapped.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: With you,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I'd have a chance to implant a Rapture core into someone special:

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: A Nikke who was handcrafted by my adorable little sister, piece by piece.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Yuni's external body had already been fused with Rapture parts, so it was already an alternative experiment in many ways.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: When the Matis Squad was corrupted, I wondered if I could potentially find a use for them.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: But then, much to my disappointment, they were healed.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: After Yuni, I didn't expect another opportunity like this to come along.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: ... I'm glad that you're satisfied.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I certainly am!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I had no idea such interesting Nikkes existed. I feel like I've been missing out.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If I'd known about you earlier, I would've taken you in back when you got shot in the head.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Hehe, if you'd done that, then this moment wouldn't be possible, would it?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Fair point.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: So what is that you're really after? Why are you so willing to subject your body to my experiments?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You had three requests. Is that really everything?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, that's everything.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Now that I think about it, your requests seem rather modest.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Why do you want to become stronger?

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Do you find you're somehow lacking when it comes to eliminating Raptures?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I want to take down Gluttony.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Ah, Gluttony!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Yes, that would be an impossible task in your current state.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: It's officially classified as a Tyrant-class, but in actuality, it's far beyond that.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: There's a reason it's named after a cardinal sin.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: didn't you receive a new body recently?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes, but I lack the ability to fully utilize its power.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: In other words, you lack talent.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I figured if anyone would have a solution, it would be you.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You figured right.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If you undergo the same experiment Yuni did, you will definitely become stronger.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: So that problem will resolve itself automatically.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: However, that means one of your wishes would have been granted without any real input from me.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: In that case, we'll say that I owe you one. You can come to me with a request later, and I'll grant it.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: No need to thank me.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You of all people should know that implanting a Rapture core onto a living Nikke

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: is akin to a death sentence.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: If you want to back out,

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: now's your last chance.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I've already gone through two memory wipes,

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: and I'm walking around with a bomb strapped to my neck.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: I'm getting used to living life on the edge.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: That may be so, but carrying two cores around is a different kind of thrill altogether.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: It's no different from the pain I've had to endure up to this point.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: All right, fine. If that's what you really want.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I'll stop playing around with the calling signal.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I'll also give you what you want when it comes to that Incubator friend of yours.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: As for the strength you desire, I will put it within your grasp.

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: But I get something in return.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: You're now my test subject for life.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I get to do whatever I want to you, and you're expected to grin and bear it.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Got that?

lines.speaker: mihara_b
lines.text: Yes. Understood.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: jien_op
lines.text: I think you're officially fit for my experimenting table.
